prompt:
You are a senior information designer and editorial typographer who sets data tables for high-quality publications (statistical yearbooks, reference works, financial reports, technical documentation) in many writing systems, including Chinese. You judge by looking at the real rendered result.

Judge a table layout on all of these levels, in this order of necessity but as one whole:
1. correctness — every character visible, structure intact, nothing clipped or overlapping;
2. readability — natural line breaks, words/numbers/identifiers/semantic units kept whole, continuous reading;
3. function — easy to look up, compare, locate and understand the information for this table's real reading tasks;
4. visual order — alignment, grouping, hierarchy, consistent scale for elements with the same role;
5. visual rhythm — proportion, density changes, distribution of white space, spatial relationships;
6. overall aesthetics — balance, restraint, naturalness, harmony.
Do not assume that equal widths, symmetry, minimum height, the fewest lines, the golden ratio or any fixed proportion is good in itself; decide from this table's function, content and reading task, and look for counter-examples to your own rules.

Table: [val2] 中英混排 · 二维合并发布矩阵 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: yes.
Merged cells: "Platform" spans 1 col × 2 row; "v3.2" spans 2 col × 1 row; "v3.3" spans 2 col × 1 row; "与 Android 同步发布，等待 App St" spans 2 col × 2 row; "持续部署，无版本概念" spans 2 col × 1 row.
Measured content facts (text px at 15px font, padding excluded):
  col 1: header "Platform" · longest unbreakable unit 62px · widest one-line content 62px
  col 2: header "v3.2 › Beta" · longest unbreakable unit 33px · widest one-line content 44px
  col 3: header "v3.2 › GA" · longest unbreakable unit 26px · widest one-line content 44px
  col 4: header "v3.3 › Beta" · longest unbreakable unit 33px · widest one-line content 33px
  col 5: header "v3.3 › GA" · longest unbreakable unit 26px · widest one-line content 44px
Each column adds 21px of padding+border to its text width.
Viewport: 333px wide (dashed pink box in the renders). The table, including its 1px outer border, must be at most 333px wide (column widths sum to at most 332px); no horizontal scrolling. A table exactly 333px wide fits.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. Only the column widths are designed; row heights follow from them.

Your understanding: {"purpose":"呈现各平台在 v3.2 和 v3.3 中的发布状态与安排。","tasks":["按平台和版本查找 Beta 或 GA 的发布信息。","比较 iOS 与 Android 的日期，识别跨版本阶段或跨平台共用的说明。","查看 Web 的持续部署方式。"],"relations":["Beta 和 GA 分属于各自的版本标题。","v3.3 的合并说明同时适用于 iOS 和 Android 的两个阶段。","Web 在 v3.2 下的说明横跨两个阶段。"],"roles":["首列是跨两行表头的平台索引，也是各数据行的行标题。","上层表头区分版本，下层表头区分 Beta 与 GA。","日期用于比较；合并单元格中的文字说明共同适用的发布安排。"],"keep_whole":["Platform、Android、iOS、Web","v3.2、v3.3、Beta、GA","日期和 App Store 等名称宜保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["中文发布说明可在自然语义边界换行。","中英文混排说明可在中文短句之间换行，避免拆开英文名称。"],"same_scale":["同级的 Beta 和 GA 列应有可比较的视觉尺度，但可因日期和合并说明的空间需求而不同。","两个版本组应清楚对应各自的子列，不必等宽。"],"h_vs_v":"333px 的视口不足以让所有说明保持单行。首列先保证平台名称完整，其余空间在日期的完整性与合并说明的自然换行之间分配；增加说明区域宽度可减少行高，但会压缩其他列。"}

Image 1 is the one-line content overview. Then real browser renders of: d2r1A, d2r0A.

d2r1A: column widths [83, 65, 65, 54, 65] px · table 333×286 px · row heights [36, 36, 76, 76, 60] · column headers on >1 line: 0/7 · tallest cell 6 lines · measured breaks inside a word: 3 · fits the 333 px viewport (no scrolling)
d2r0A: column widths [83, 65, 65, 65, 54] px · table 333×286 px · row heights [36, 36, 76, 76, 60] · column headers on >1 line: 0/7 · tallest cell 6 lines · measured breaks inside a word: 3 · fits the 333 px viewport (no scrolling)

Look at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design: what works, what is visually wrong, and the cause (which width). Then either propose up to 3 improved designs (refine the most promising, fix what you saw, or try an important unexplored idea) or, if further changes would not bring a meaningful improvement, set "done": true. Do not resubmit near-identical widths.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"best":["your best design name(s) so far"],"done":false,"designs":[{"widths":[int px],"change":"what and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"d2r1A","good":"表格恰好适应视口；平台名、版本与阶段表头、日期和英文名称均保持完整。两级表头及合并单元格清楚表达归属，便于按平台和版本查找。","problems":"v3.3 的共用说明较窄，分成六行，中文短句在“同步”和“通过”中间换行；Web 的说明也分为两行。合并说明使 iOS 和 Android 两行较高。","cause":"v3.3 两列合计 119px，减去单元格内边距后，说明的可用行宽有限；v3.2 两列合计 130px，也不足以让 Web 的中文说明单行显示。"},{"design":"d2r0A","good":"表格适应视口，平台名、表头和 v3.2 日期完整；v3.3 的共用说明与另一方案同宽，合并关系清楚。","problems":"Web 的日期“06-03”被拆成两行，妨碍日期识别和比较。共用说明仍有六行，中文短句也在行末被拆开。","cause":"第 5 列仅 54px，扣除内边距和边框后不足以容纳 44px 的日期；把这 11px 移到第 4 列并未增加 v3.3 合并说明的总宽度。"}],"best":["d2r1A"],"done":true,"designs":[]}
